failure_modes.description: The assumption that neural networks can effectively learn complex building parameter relationships is unfounded without specifying architecture, size, or training methodology
failure_modes.evidence: Neural networks require careful architectural design and massive datasets to avoid overfitting in complex control systems

failure_modes.description: Stomatal regulation evolved for gas exchange in plants, not for optimizing energy efficiency in buildings - fundamental mismatch in objectives
failure_modes.evidence: Stomata regulate CO2/O2 exchange with water conservation as primary constraint, not energy optimization

failure_modes.description: Building ventilation systems have different scale, time constants, and failure modes than cellular systems
failure_modes.evidence: Neural networks designed for cellular processes cannot directly translate to building-scale systems without complete re-engineering

failure_modes.description: Numerous existing neural network HVAC control systems have been developed without resorting to biological analogies
failure_modes.evidence: Multiple papers on neural network HVAC controls exist without biological inspiration

failure_modes.description: The hypothesis admits it could fail to converge during training, which is highly likely given the complexity of the problem
failure_modes.evidence: The hypothesis itself identifies failure to converge as a potential falsifier, indicating fundamental weakness

failure_modes.description: Building ventilation requires predictable, explainable control decisions, while neural networks are inherently black-box
failure_modes.evidence: Safety-critical building systems require transparent decision-making, which neural networks cannot provide
